name: PK InExPress
author: Fatur

sections.description:
Fast and reliable XML importer from real estate CRMs to WordPress.
Supports Quick Import, Manual Import, asynchronous processing, taxonomy and feature synchronization, and automatic media handling.
Current Quick Import integrations include RealSoftware and MioGest to Houzez and Estatik.
Manual Import also allows custom XML mappings to supported destinations.

Extended Description

PK InExPress connects management platforms (CRMs) and XML feeds with WordPress destinations that require structured data.

The plugin reads XML data, normalizes the content, assigns supported taxonomies and features, and creates or updates WordPress content according to the selected destination.

Quick Import provides predefined integrations for supported management systems, while Manual Import allows users to create and save custom XML mappings.

The asynchronous import engine processes data in small batches to improve stability and reduce the risk of server timeouts. Quick Import also includes recovery mechanisms for temporary server errors and connection interruptions.

Current Quick Import integrations include:

  • RealSoftware → Houzez
  • RealSoftware → Estatik
  • MioGest → Houzez
  • MioGest → Estatik

Manual Import allows XML data from other CRMs and custom XML feeds to be imported by creating a custom field mapping.

Supported Manual Import destinations are:

  • Houzez
  • Estatik
  • InExPress Posts

This means Manual Import is not limited to RealSoftware or MioGest. Any compatible XML feed can be mapped to one of the supported destinations.

The system is designed to be extended to additional CRMs, XML formats and WordPress destinations.

The interface allows you to:

  • Import supported XML feeds using Quick Import.
  • Create custom XML mappings using Manual Import.
  • Process imports asynchronously in small batches.
  • Automatically create or update supported taxonomies, features, media and custom fields.
  • Update existing imported content without creating unnecessary duplicates.
  • Synchronize supported property data with Houzez and Estatik.
  • Recover more safely from temporary server or Internet connection problems during Quick Import.
  • Handle large image sets with optional resizing (Pro version).

PK InExPress does not send imported XML data to Punkode.
When importing from an XML URL, the plugin connects to the URL provided by the user to retrieve the XML feed and related media.
Import processing and WordPress content creation are performed on your WordPress site.

Disclaimer

PK InExPress imports XML data from external sources.
The plugin author is not responsible for the correctness, legality, or licensing of the imported XML.
Users must ensure they have the right to use such data according to applicable agreements and laws.

External services

PK InExPress does not require a Punkode external API to perform imports.

When the user configures an external XML URL, the plugin connects to that URL to retrieve the XML feed and, when applicable, related images or media.

The XML URL and imported data are provided and controlled by the user. Import data is not sent to Punkode.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the pk-inexpress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate PK InExPress from the “Plugins” screen.
  3. Open PK InExPress → Quick Import to use one of the predefined CRM integrations.
  4. Select the source management system, destination and XML URL, then start the import.
  5. To import a custom XML structure, open PK InExPress → Manual Import, configure the mapping and run the import.
sections.faq:
Which CRMs and destinations are supported?

Quick Import currently supports:

  • RealSoftware → Houzez
  • RealSoftware → Estatik
  • MioGest → Houzez
  • MioGest → Estatik

Manual Import is not limited to these CRMs. It allows custom XML feeds from other management systems to be mapped and imported into:

  • Houzez
  • Estatik
  • InExPress Posts

Can I use this with other WordPress themes or plugins?

PK InExPress currently includes dedicated integrations for Houzez and Estatik.
Manual Import provides additional flexibility for supported destinations.
More destinations may be added in future releases.

Does it support cron jobs (automatic scheduled imports)?

Yes. PK InExPress Pro supports automatic scheduled imports using WP-Cron.

The Pro version also includes optional image resizing to reduce the size of imported media and help improve site performance.
sections.changelog:
1.2.3

  • Security: Improved validation of remote XML and media URLs to prevent unsafe internal requests (SSRF).
  • Maintenance: Improved WordPress coding standards compliance and Plugin Check compatibility.
  • Maintenance: Cleaned up the production package and readme metadata.

1.2.2

  • Improved Quick Import stability and reliability.
  • Reduced Quick Import batch size to minimize server timeouts during heavy imports.
  • Added safer delays between asynchronous import requests.
  • Improved handling of temporary server errors and 504 Gateway Timeout responses.
  • Added automatic retry with progressive delays when temporary errors occur.
  • Added automatic pause when the browser loses its Internet connection.
  • Quick Import now automatically resumes when the Internet connection is restored.
  • Improved protection against stalled import batches.
  • Improved Quick Import progress interface.

1.2.1

  • Fixed latitude and longitude handling for property imports and updates.
  • Improved coordinate normalization to correctly support decimal values using commas or dots.
  • Resolved an issue that could cause latitude and longitude values to be truncated, resulting in incorrect map positions.
  • This fix also improves compatibility with properties imported using previous versions of INexpress.

1.2.0

  • Added Estatik as a Manual Import destination.
  • Added verified Estatik mapping fields for property data, location, taxonomies, video and images.
  • Added generic Estatik manual importer and runner with saved mapping support.
  • Added asynchronous Manual Import support for Estatik.
  • Added Quick Import support for RealSoftware → Estatik.
  • Added Quick Import support for MioGest → Estatik.

1.1.11

  • Added the missing modules directory to the WordPress.org package.
  • Removed the need to manually enter the word “Codice” in the configuration field.
  • The “Codice” prefix is now handled automatically by InExPress.

1.1.10

  • New: Added Property Slideshow module.
  • New: Fullscreen slideshow page optimized for TVs and office displays.
  • New: Dedicated Slideshow administration page.
  • New: Public slideshow URL with quick open and copy actions.
  • Improved: Responsive slideshow layout and property information display.
  • Improved: Better compatibility with different screen sizes.

1.1.9

  • add slide show property.

1.1.8

  • Fixed MioGest property type.

1.1.7

  • Fixed MioGest contract type mapping. Property status is now correctly set.

1.1.6

  • Update freemius.

1.1.5

  • Corrections for a better translation.

1.1.4

  • New: Added manual AJAX import (Quick Import) with step-based processing.
  • New: Real-time progress display in the admin interface (processed / total).
  • New: Import and update now run in safe micro-batches to prevent server timeouts.
  • Improved stability when handling large XML files and heavy image sets.
  • Improved error reporting during asynchronous import.

1.1.2

*With realsoftware, it takes the names of agents even if they are written with an accent on the theme and without an accent in the management system.

1.1.1

  • Added support for Miogest to Houzez integration

1.0.1

  • Added Freemius integration

1.0.0

  • First public release
  • Supports import from Realsoftware to Houzez
